title: WoDX Rules
description: World of Darkness Expanded: the rules core. The game's rules as plain code with no Foundry calls, shared by every WoDX module: time and dice terms, the calendar and, as they move in, each module's rules files. Nothing runs when it loads; the other modules import its files. Install it with the other WoDX modules; it does not need switching on. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
